purpose: Pretraining-resource proxy per language, sourced not estimated (protocol §8)

source.name: CC-100 monolingual corpora
source.role: training corpus of XLM-R (Conneau et al. 2020), which supplies the tokenizer and pretrained base for encoder family A
source.verification: VERIFIED - fetched from the official distribution page in-session
source.units: compressed text size as published on the source page; converted to MB for ordering only

caveats: This is a proxy for the BASE MODEL's pretraining volume, not for the full training pipeline of the sentence encoders. paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 is distilled using parallel data on top of an XLM-R initialisation, so CC-100 volume does not capture its distillation supervision. Must be stated in Limitations.
Applies to the XLM-R tokenizer family (models A, A2). The mBERT family (B, B2) was pretrained on Wikipedia, so a separate Wikipedia-size proxy is required for those. EVIDENCE REQUIRED.
MIRACL Chinese is Simplified, so zh-Hans (14G) is used; zh-Hant (5.3G) is recorded but not used.
Sizes are compressed bytes, not token counts. Compression ratio varies by script, so cross-script comparison of these values is approximate. Rank ordering is more defensible than absolute ratios.

counterintuitive_orderings: id (36G) exceeds es and fr (14G each), so 'low-resource' intuitions do not track CC-100 volume
observations.why_this_matters: The proxy is a measured covariate with real, non-obvious variation rather than a restatement of which languages are assumed to be low-resource. That is what makes it usable as a predictor instead of a label.
